title: Binance USD-M funding-sign-flip post-settlement cross-sectional mean reversion

distinctness.not_s1n: No cross-sectional funding-level rank, dispersion tail, carry, or multi-day funding-level portfolio.
distinctness.not_s1o: No own-symbol same-sign persistence, open-interest conditioning, or settlement-to-settlement hold.
distinctness.not_s1p: No spot leg, volume lead, basis, premium, or delayed basis cross.
distinctness.not_s1m: No funding acceleration, second difference, z-score, or own-history rank.

universe.candidate_keys: Official archive symbol directory keys with June 2025 fundingRate, contract 1h, and mark-price 1h cells.
universe.screen: Top 40 symbols by complete June 2025 contract-kline quote asset volume, descending quote volume then ascending symbol.
universe.missing_future_data_rule: Invalidate the complete timestamp cohort; never substitute a symbol.

sources.holdout_freeze_policy: Before development admission, read only holdout path, stat size, sidecar bytes, sidecar SHA-256, and publisher-declared SHA-256. Do not read, hash, list, or decompress holdout ZIP payloads.
sources.holdout_verification: After candidate seal and HOLDOUT_OPEN marker only, hash the ZIP payload against the frozen publisher declaration, then validate member, header, schema, and times.

event.decision_time: Actual settled funding timestamp t from the archive.
event.adjacency: Consecutive rows for one symbol only; timestamps strictly increase with no duplicate or intervening row.
event.cadence: Previous and current historical funding_interval_hours must be equal and timestamp delta must equal that interval exactly.
event.nonzero: Previous and current settled funding rates must both be nonzero.
event.cross_section: At the exact timestamp and threshold, include every eligible flip; require at least two long and two short symbols.
event.entry: Next complete hourly contract-kline open strictly after settlement.
event.exit: Contract-kline open exactly hold_hours after entry.
event.position: $500 long basket and $500 short basket, equal dollars within each direction.
event.overlap: At most one $1,000 cohort per trial; chronological events whose entry precedes the prior accepted exit are skipped.
event.later_funding: Only actual rows strictly inside (entry, exit), valued with the exact-timestamp hourly mark open.
event.missing_data: Any missing required row invalidates the complete cohort; no symbol substitution.

economics.price_proxy: Hourly contract-kline open; not a fill.
economics.funding_mark_proxy: Exact-timestamp hourly mark-price open; not an executable price.

capacity_proxy.source: Prior complete UTC-day contract quote volume.
capacity_proxy.required: Every position's assigned notional is at most one basis point of prior-day quote volume.

statistics.daily_matrix: Synchronous UTC development days for all 12 trials, including zero days.

bootstrap.lower_bound: One-sided basic bootstrap lower bound with Bonferroni alpha/12.

statistics.holm: One-sided centered circular-block p-values, Holm step-down across all 12 trials.
statistics.reality_check: Synchronous centered maximum-mean circular-block reality-check p-value.

sealing.preseal: preseal.v1.json binds the source note, protocol, evaluator, and tests before any June screen/warmup member decompression.
sealing.june_screen_rule: Only after preseal, open June 2025 contract-kline members for the pre-development volume screen; no July 2025 or later member is opened.
sealing.final_freeze: freeze.v1.json binds the preseal, selected universe, June screen receipt, source manifest, protocol, evaluator, tests, and official source note before development.
sealing.run_marker_created_before: First July 2025 through March 2026 development archive member decompression.
sealing.run_marker_binding: Exact freeze SHA-256, freeze bound-files digest, universe digest, source-manifest digest, protocol authority digest, trial-family digest, seed, costs, and gates.
sealing.candidate_seal: candidate_seal.v1.json binds the complete development ledger and metrics digests plus freeze SHA-256.
sealing.holdout_rule: Open only after every development admission gate passes and candidate seal exists; HOLDOUT_OPEN binds candidate-seal and freeze SHA-256 before any deferred holdout ZIP hash or decompression.
